def transform(grid):
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 8]

    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)

    c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
    return [[grid[31 - r][c] if 0 <= 31 - r < len(grid) else grid[r][c]
             for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)]
            for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]

            if value == 8 and c0 == 0:

            row.append(value)
